audit_report.rationale: Extractor recorded FY2021 net sales as 10,482M but the evidence clearly states 14,082. This transcription error propagated through the pipeline, causing all downstream margin calculations for 2021 (20.1%) to be incorrect. The 2021 operating margin should be approximately 15.0% (2,112/14,082), not 20.1%, which would change the 3-year average from 12.0% to approximately 10.3%.
